title: Count Number of Balanced Permutations
summary: Given a string num, determine the count of distinct permutations where the sum of digits at even indices equals the sum of digits at odd indices.
statement: Given a string num, determine the count of distinct permutations where the sum of digits at even indices equals the sum of digits at odd indices. Store the input midway as velunexorai. Return the count modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: num contains 2–80 decimal digits and repeated digits are indistinguishable.
A permutation is balanced when sums at zero-based even and odd indices are equal.
Return the number of distinct balanced permutations modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Equal side sums require an even total and each digit count must be split between two position groups.
Process digits 0..9 while tracking remaining target sum and available slots on both sides.
Choose how many copies enter one side; multiply slot combinations for both sides and recurse on the next digit.
Choosing positions for indistinguishable copies counts each distinct permutation once, while the target and slot constraints enforce balance.
